sheets.prompt: Interior concept art for a science fiction exploration game: a long potting hall inside a greenhouse of the white builders, clean gridded white stone walls, long white stone potting benches with dead sticks in pots, a roof of louvres high above. A stone ball has just rolled onto a plate at the end of its groove, and a louvre over the benches has turned: a sunbeam swings off the floor onto a carved stone eye behind the benches that was in shade, dust bright in the beam. A cloaked adult human traveller of ordinary height with a round jade fluid backpack stands by the plate, a splash of glowing fluid arcing toward the newly sunlit eye, dwarfed by the hall. Frieze of three dots over an upward arc. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, white stone, sunlit glass, leaf green, petal pink, sky blue, soft blue shadows, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, watermark, lettering, labels.
